_note: THE PROBE CASE IS NEW, and the reason it did not exist was wrong. The
fixture header said versions rows 'come from IndexedDB, so a probe would
capture the empty list and call it a pass'. They do not: reloadDbVersions
calls `listAssetVersions`, which is a tRPC read over the wire
(MediaVersionService:34), and this probe has answered that transport for
the review surfaces since they were boarded. So `media-versions` stubs
`media.listAssetVersions` and the overlay mounts exactly as it ships. The
old reasoning is what left a four-row board measured against a screen that
had none — the same shape as USAGE_COMPOSER never answering
getUsagesByPage. The wait names a ROW, not the panel, so an empty list
cannot pass as this state.
THE VERSION ROWS ARE JOINED TO 75:71 / 75:77 / 75:83, NOT to this board's
own 241:1444 / 241:1452 / 241:1460, and that needs saying plainly. This
board draws every row 56 tall, full-bleed and square (radius 4, no fill).
Board 75:59's card draws the same rows as 44-high bg-subtle chips on a 6
radius at a 10 inset — the same box as the CURRENT version, which
boards.json already records as drift-fixed against 75:65 (2026-09-08).
Two boards disagree and the verified one stands; but the code was
following NEITHER: it shipped a 44 chip for the current version directly
above 56-tall full-bleed rows for the older ones, which reads as two
different lists stacked. Conformed to the chip, so the joins are real
measurements rather than a decision deferred.
BOARD WON — 146:64, THE RESTORE CONFIRM, and this is the one that matters
on this screen. It shipped as a 32-high strip reading 'Restore?'. The
board's band is 84 tall and says what restoring costs: 'Restore this
version? It is used in 3 places — those will update too.' Asking for an
irreversible decision while withholding the single fact needed to make it
is not a size difference. The place count is real (`usageCount`), and the
clause is dropped entirely when the asset is used nowhere rather than
printing 'used in 0 places'.
ALSO FIXED, found by conforming rather than by looking: the current chip's
children carried mt-4 / ml-5 / ml-3 / mt-2.5 / mr-4 — absolute-era offsets
left over from when the row was 56 tall and full-bleed. Inside a 44 chip
that is `items-center` with gap-10 and px-10 they push every child below
the centre line. The chip's own box measured green against 75:65 the whole
time, because a diff of a container cannot see where its children sit.
NOT JOINED, and why: 146:37 / 146:38, the back row at 56 — 146:7, 147:7
and 147:60 all give the same shared control 36, which is what ships and
what media-drill-in-asset-detail measured green; three frames to two does
not re-settle a shared row. 146:65, the confirm's sentence, carries
w-248: Figma strokes do not consume layout and CSS borders do, so the 1px
gray-100 edge this board itself mandates leaves the child at 246 (the
media-no-results note records the same arithmetic). 75:65 (the current
chip) is measured by media-drill-ins-the-five-destinations and is not
joined twice. 1720:17375 is a hotspot.
CONTRAST, BOARD-MANDATED AND DECLARED — 2 failures, neither introduced by
this pass. 'current' is --bk-ink-muted on the accent-tint chip at 4.38:1
(pre-existing; already recorded on media-drill-ins-the-five-destinations).
'Cancel' is --bk-ink-muted on the confirm band's --bk-bg-subtle at 4.39:1 —
146:66 names ink-muted and 146:64 names bg-subtle, so the board pins both
halves and conforming cannot fix it. The band was already that pair when it
was 32 tall; making it 84 did not create it. Standing
CONTRAST-INK-MUTED.md defect; the fix is ink-soft at 7.0:1 and deviates
from a board that names the token.
